Get to know me ↘
Always looking for the next horizon

A little more about me 01

Life should be
an adventure.

Educator.
Teammate.
Explorer.
Dog person.

I believe the person you are outside the classroom has a real influence on the teacher you become.

Sport, travel and adventure have always been important parts of my life. From rugby pitches to mountain trails, I enjoy a challenge, discovering unfamiliar places and the friendships that grow from shared experiences.

These experiences have taught me about resilience, perspective and supporting other people. They have also reminded me to stay curious, keep learning and find humour when things don't go according to plan.

I take my responsibilities as an educator seriously. I just don't think that means taking myself too seriously.

The great outdoors 02

Choose the
long way round.

I love the mountains—hiking, skiing, travelling and the sense of perspective that comes from being somewhere bigger than yourself.

△

“A little discomfort, a new perspective and a good story to tell afterwards.”

Sport & camaraderie 03

Part of
the team.

Rugby and other team sports have shaped how I think about leadership: show up, work hard, support the people around you, and enjoy the experience together.

The lighter side 04

Dogs, fresh air
& a sense of humour.

Outside school, you'll often find me exploring with my dogs. And yes, occasionally doing something completely ridiculous. I think a bit of humour goes a long way.

The connection to education

The same curiosity.
Inside and outside school.
